class.name: SuperposField
class.description: Compiled into the EGP engine through its native Superpos module. Full-width unsigned values use signed opaque Variant bits in GDScript and unsigned native metadata in generated C# and C++ bindings.

members.member: Core FieldAudience value in the range 0 through 2. This is schema metadata, not an application authentication policy.
Canonical codec identifier in the range 1 through 10. Its bounds and byte layout must match the corresponding Superpos core FieldKind.
Nonzero field identifier, unique within the schema. Preserve its full unsigned bits. Fields are sorted by this ID when baking.

ASCII field name containing letters, digits or underscores, with a maximum length of 64 characters. It may also be an indexed property path of at most four names separated by single colons, such as [code]position:x[/code]; [method SuperposReplicator.bind_schema] binds each field to the property path in its name.
Canonical byte width for this field. The codec and total schema state size impose additional bounds checked when baking.
Maximum numeric bound used by codecs that require a bounded range.
Minimum numeric bound used by codecs that require a bounded range.
Number of quantization levels for codecs that require quantization. The schema validates its compatibility with the selected codec.
